name: Kirchenwirt
beschreibung: The Kirchenwirt in Schwoich, Tirol, is centrally located in the village, directly next to the church. The surroundings are characterized by mountains and meadows that invite you to go hiking. The inn offers traditional rooms and regional cuisine in the restaurant. The atmosphere is cosy and family-friendly, typical of a Tiroler family-run business. The amenities include a beer garden and free Wi-Fi. The target audience is hikers, cyclists, and holidaymakers who appreciate peace and nature. The outdoor dining area is especially popular in summer. Guests can take excursions from here into the Kaisergebirge.
